summary.pack_description:
Collect some of the most memorable and exciting moments from the 2025 Stanley Cup-winning team with the Hoist the Cup 2025 Encore Pack, celebrating the Florida Panthers capturing their back-to-back championship. Relive some of the thrilling goals, spectacular saves, and defining plays that led to hoisting the Stanley Cup in victory.

Each pack contains 3 Core mystery highlights that could be from Base 2024-25 (50%) or Fresh Sweaters (50%), and 1 mystery highlight that could be from The Hunt for Stanley 2025 (61%), Hoist the Cup 2025 (26%), Making the Mark 2024-25 (8.52%), Set the Tone (2.4%), Take a Bow (2%), or Etched in Ice (< 1%)

release.name: Hoist the Cup 2025 Encore Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Tuesday, August 19 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

 

Price: $9 USD

# Packs Available: 2,500 packs total. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

 

Purchase Limit: Fifteen (15) pack limit per person for the first 6 hours; the limit increases to a sixty (60) pack limit per person afterward. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 4

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • Three (3) highlights with the following probabilities:
    • 50% Base 2024-25 (Core #/1500)
    • 50% Fresh Sweaters (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 61% The Hunt for Stanley 2025 (Limited #/500)
    • 26% Hoist the Cup 2025 (Rare #/250)
    • 8.52% Making the Mark 2024-25 (Epic #/100)
    • 2.4% Set the Tone (Limited #/500)
    • 2% Take a Bow (Epic #/100)
    • 0.08% Etched in Ice (Legendary #/10)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. 

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Highlights List
  • Base 2024-25, Series 2 - Preview
  • Fresh Sweaters, Series 2 - Preview
  • The Hunt for Stanley 2025, Series 2 - Preview
  • Hoist the Cup 2025, Preview
  • Making the Mark 2024-25, Series 2 - Preview
  • Set the Tone, Preview
  • Take a Bow, Series 2 - Preview
  • Etched in Ice, Series 2 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 2 highlights will only be distributed during Series 2, which ends prior to the start of the 2025-26 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Base 2024-25
summary.description: Gear up for a season-long thrill ride with Base 2024-25! This Core set is packed with can’t-miss moments: from electrifying goals and crisp apples to heavy hits, clutch defensive plays, and jaw-dropping goalie saves. Whether it’s a game-breaking snipe, a tape-to-tape gem, or a showstopping glove save, each highlight chronicles the key plays of the 2024-25 NHL regular season.

summary.name: Fresh Sweaters
summary.description: Celebrate the excitement of a fresh start with the Fresh Sweaters Core set, featuring players making their mark with their new NHL teams. Each highlight captures a standout moment—whether it's a snipe, an apple, a great defensive play, a hit, or a jaw-dropping save. Relive the impact of players as they introduce themselves to new fans and teammates, setting the tone for the next chapter in their careers and defining their journey with a new franchise.

summary.name: The Hunt for Stanley 2025
summary.description: The Hunt for Stanley 2025 features the most exhilarating highlights from the first three rounds of the 2025 Stanley Cup Playoffs. This set showcases the intense battles, dramatic goals, and game-changing plays that defined the quest for hockey's ultimate prize. Relive the passion and excitement as teams fought tirelessly to keep their championship dreams alive.

summary.name: Hoist the Cup 2025
summary.description: Hoist the Cup 2025 celebrates the triumphs of the 2025 Stanley Cup champions. This annual Rare collection captures the most electrifying moments from the Florida Panthers journey through the Stanley Cup Playoffs. Relive the thrilling goals, spectacular saves, and defining plays that led to hockey's ultimate glory. Each highlight in this set commemorates the skill, determination, and passion that culminated in hoisting the coveted Stanley Cup.

summary.name: Making the Mark 2024-25
summary.description: Making the Mark 2024-25 celebrates extraordinary single-season and career milestones from the 2024-25 NHL regular season. This seasonal Epic set highlights two record-breaking goalie achievements, a rare goalie goal, and other standout feats. These defining moments not only showcase players at their best but also cement their place in NHL history, leaving an indelible mark on the game.

summary.name: Set the Tone
summary.description: Introducing Set the Tone, a captivating compilation of body checks that exemplify the aspect of physical play in hockey. This Limited set celebrates the players' remarkable ability to create opportunities and shift momentum through skillfully executed hits. Witness body checks that ignite team spirit and fuel excitement, all while upholding the true essence of sportsmanship in the game. Experience the thrill of impactful plays that leave a lasting impression on fans and players alike.

summary.name: Take A Bow
summary.description: Enter the realm of hockey's rich history through Take a Bow, a commemorative collection that honors revered retired players achieving career-defining milestones. These moments, which once ignited arenas with sheer excitement, range from players entering the prestigious 500-goal club, marking their 1,000th point or a goalie earning his 400th win. Take a Bow is a celebration of their lasting impact on the sport, reliving the thrills that turned them into household names. With carefully curated Epic highlights, this set captures the essence of their charisma and skill, reminding us why they remain ingrained in our hearts.

summary.name: Sidney Crosby
summary.description:
Since Sidney Crosby joined the NHL in the 2005-06 season, no player has amassed more points than he has. A proven winner on every stage, Crosby first claimed gold at the 2005 World Junior Championship. He then earned global recognition at the 2010 Winter Olympics in Vancouver, where he famously scored the overtime game-winning goal to secure gold for Team Canada. His success continued as he captained Canada to a second consecutive Olympic gold in 2014. The following year, he led the team to victory at the World Championship in Prague, making him a member of the prestigious Triple Gold Club—the only player to have captained all three winning teams. In 2016, Crosby once again led Canada to gold at the World Cup of Hockey, where he was unanimously voted MVP.  
In the NHL, Crosby has captained the Pittsburgh Penguins to three Stanley Cup championships. One iconic moment came in 2009 during Game 4 of the Stanley Cup Final, where Crosby scored a crucial game-winning goal to tie the series against Detroit, ultimately leading the Penguins to a seven-game victory and his first Stanley Cup championship. In March 2018, Crosby showcased his incredible hand-eye coordination by juggling the puck to himself before batting it out of the air and into the net. Another standout moment occurred during the 2016 Stanley Cup Final against Tampa Bay in Game 2, where Crosby netted the overtime winner to even the series at home. That year, he claimed the Conn Smythe Trophy, an honor he would win again the following season.

summary.name: Nathan MacKinnon
summary.description:
Hart Trophy winner, Nathan MacKinnon has been a dominant force for the Colorado Avalanche throughout his first 11 seasons. His impact on the NHL was immediate, earning the Calder Trophy during his rookie campaign in 2013-14.  
In the first highlight sequence, MacKinnon’s explosive skating is on full display as he blows past the Islanders' defense and scores a breathtaking goal during his rookie season. The second sequence showcases his relentless determination in a December 2018 game against the Coyotes. MacKinnon starts by delivering a big hit to keep the puck in the zone, causing a turnover. Later in the shift, he regains possession, fakes a shot to outmaneuver a defender, and fires a goal past the goaltender.  
In his ninth NHL season, MacKinnon captured his first Stanley Cup in 2022. During the Western Conference Second Round, he delivered the signature goal of the playoffs. In Game 5 against the St. Louis Blues, MacKinnon picked up the puck deep behind his own goal line and went coast-to-coast, scoring a sensational goal—his third of the game. Hats rained down from the home crowd, who were left in awe of his brilliance.
